text: EX-99.1 2 tm2629302d1_ex99-1.htm EXHIBIT 99.1 Exhibit 99.1 PRESS RELEASE NRG Energy Announces $4 Billion Asset Sale Transaction monetizes select assets at an attractive valuation, supporting additional share repurchases, debt reduction, and flexibility to redeploy capital at higher returns. HOUSTON – November 9, 2026 – NRG Energy, Inc. (NYSE: NRG) today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to sell six natural gas generation assets to LS Power, for a purchase price of $4 billion in cash, subject to working capital and other closing adjustments. The purchase price represents an implied 2027 valuation multiple of 8.0x EV/Adj. EBITDA. "We are unlocking substantial value from a select group of assets, while maintaining a robust generation footprint in PJM and ERCOT that provides reliable, affordable power for our customers," said Robert Gaudette, President and Chief Executive Officer of NRG. "This transaction will strengthen our balance sheet, support increased share repurchases and preserve flexibility to invest in growth opportunities with compelling returns. It demonstrates our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and creates long-term value for shareholders." The sale is targeted to close in the second quarter of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals, including Hart-Scott-Rodino (HSR), Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC), and the New York State Public Service Commission (NYSPSC). The six assets represent 4.9 GW of generation across NYISO (Ravenswood), ISO-NE (Ocean State Power and Wallingford), and ERCOT (Jack County, Johnson County, and R.W. Miller). NRG remains dedicated to ensuring affordable, reliable power as demand continues to grow. Upon completion, NRG will own and operate 20 GW of generation capacity nationwide. This includes 10 GW of generation in ERCOT, complemented by 10 GW in PJM. By 2028, an additional 1.1 GW is expected to be operational in ERCOT through the Company’s remaining two Texas Energy Fund projects. Proceeds from the transaction will be used to support NRG's 2027 pro forma capital allocation plan of $3 billion of share repurchases across 2026 and 2027, including an incremental $1 billion expected to begin before the end of the fourth quarter of 2026. Upon closing of the asset sale, NRG plans an additional $2 billion of debt reduction to maintain the Company’s current leverage profile, bringing total planned 2027 debt reduction to $3 billion. The remaining proceeds will be reserved to fund either contracted growth investments or additional debt reduction. Barclays is serving as lead financial advisor on the transaction and White & Case LLP is serving as legal counsel to NRG. Conference Call and Webcast NRG will discuss the transaction during its previously announced earnings conference call on November 9 at 8:00 AM EST / 7:00 AM CST. Investors, members of the media and the public may access the webcast and presentation materials through NRG's Investor Relations website at www.nrg.com. PRESS RELEASE About NRG NRG is a leading provider of electricity, natural gas, and smart home solutions to eight million customers across North America. The company operates a customer-first platform supported by a diversified supply strategy and the safe, reliable operation of approximately 25 GW of power generation. NRG plays a meaningful role in competitive energy markets, and our innovative team is creating the flexible and affordable solutions that households and large businesses need today and in the future.
